definitions.supported: CI-certified on every release; security fixes backported to supported release lines
definitions.best_effort: expected to work; not CI-gated; bugs fixed when practical
definitions.deprecated: supported until the announced end-of-support date; at least 180 days notice (security emergencies may shorten to 30 days)

isolation_profiles.process (isolation.run_isolated): supported on POSIX; Windows without rlimits = best_effort

mixed_version: Minor versions within one MAJOR interoperate; references never cross processes so mixed versions share only config/audit/evidence schemas, which are versioned and refused when unsupported.
downgrade: Allowed within the same MAJOR if the active config schema is supported by the target; config rollback uses ConfigStore.rollback.
